content: Installed qwen2.5-coder:7b and created qwen-coder-7b-local:latest; standalone health reported Ollama ready with exact model available; full root and GUI tests, TypeScript, production build, whitespace, Markdown size, and secret audits passed; reviewed all pending Vector, framework, portability, Continue, and Hangar changes for commit.

Implemented VECTOR_GUI_AGENT_UPGRADE_v2: standalone loopback agent backend with centralized qwen-coder-7b-local configuration, repository-scoped file/search/diff tools, approved argument-array commands, real validated projects, AGENTS and project-learning lifecycle integration, grounded GUI activity, read-only reviews, calm failure states, attachment vision support, one canonical chat, and Windows/Linux supervision; 34 automated tests, TypeScript, production build, security scans, runtime start/stop, cross-origin rejection, and missing-model reporting verified; required 7B alias is not installed on this home machine so real 7B inference remains to verify at the office

Made Vector portable across Windows and Debian: added safe Debian start/stop scripts, portable Python npm launcher, setup guide, LF/executable policy, POSIX project routing, clone-relative README authority, and portability tests; verified POSIX syntax, 23 Python tests, 11 presence tests, TypeScript, and production build

Reviewed Continue against current official documentation; added VS Code extension recommendation, workspace-local qwen3:4b Ollama model with tool use and bounded context, concrete AGENTS lifecycle rule, setup diagnostics, and three passing configuration tests; verified Ollama endpoint/model and framework tests

Reviewed full pending Vector change set; fixed training eligibility diversity guard and FAILED_SAFE health precedence; Python framework, Python Hangar, standalone tests, TypeScript check, and production build passed; no secret patterns or whitespace errors found

Converted Hangar environment, generator, evaluator, and Q-learning agent to Python; removed JavaScript Hangar; 18 Python tests passed; trained 1600 episodes and achieved 120/120 held-out launches at 6.07 mean actions. README audit: 39 requirements implemented, 14 partial, so puzzle is not yet fully solved.

Repaired verified framework defects: schema v2, complete Step 3 responsibilities, health/stall/recovery commands, bounded recovery evidence, JSONL memory, enriched context/status, atomic locking, dataset governance, model/evaluation persistence, and 21 passing tests
